title: neottia tianschanica
intro: Neottia tianschanica, commonly known as Tianschan orchid, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Neottia tianschanica include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which can help to relieve fever, reduce swelling, and heal wounds. The bioactive constituents of Neottia tianschanica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, anti-oxidation, and immune-enhancement.
